title: Alexander Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Positioned prominently between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach lies this incredible 3 bedroom 3 bathroom rental condo in the highly sought after Alexander development.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Newly Renovated – All 3 Bathrooms Updated + New Flooring Throughout • 3 King Suites | 3 Full Bathrooms – Ideal for Couples or Group Getaways • Large Smart TVs in Every Bedroom & Living Area • Oversized Open-Air Balcony with Comfortable Seating & Scenic Views • High-End Furnishings & Coastal-Inspired Design Throughout • 2 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes • Private Beach Access • Fully Stocked Kitchen with Granite Countertops & Modern Appliances • Sandpiper Linen Program – Premium Linens, Bedding & Towels Included ✨OPTIONAL ADD-ONS✨ →Vacation Cancellation Protection - Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) NEWLY RENOVATED and perfectly positioned between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, this stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo is located in the highly sought-after Alexander development along Scenic Highway 30A. Unit 203, located on the second floor, offers an elevated coastal experience with upscale finishes, including travertine flooring, custom wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and a spacious private balcony overlooking the beauty of Alys Beach. LUXURY COASTAL LIVING Designed for comfort and style, this beautifully updated condo features an open-concept living space, tray ceilings, updated lighting, and elegant finishes throughout. The fully equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas—perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a day at the beach. Step outside to your oversized private balcony and enjoy breathtaking sunsets and sweeping views along 30A. The primary suite offers private balcony access through large glass doors, a walk-in closet, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with comfort and privacy in mind. PRIME 30A LOCATION Located between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, you’ll be within walking or biking distance to some of the best: ✔️ Restaurants & Dining on 30A ✔️ Boutique Shopping & Local Markets ✔️ Beach Access Points & Scenic Bike Paths ✔️ Entertainment & Seasonal Events This location is ideal for guests looking to experience the best of 30A vacation rentals with convenience and style. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6) • Bedroom 1: Primary Suite – King Bed | Smart TV | En-Suite Bath (Walk-In Shower) • Bedroom 2:Guest Suite – King Bed | Smart TV | En-Suite Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom – King Bed | Smart TV | Access to Hall Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) ✨IMPORTANT DETAILS ✨ Private beach Access No pool access with this property Sorry, no pets allowed Must be 25+years old to rent FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
